proofs.expected: src/optimize/ ceilings and rules run on this credit file and fire something useful for optimize+letters
proofs.observed: src/optimize is ad-spend autopilot (ROAS/CPA/frequency/CTR/kill). Entry runDailyOptimization requires orgId+partnerId, not client_id. evaluate() on this file = []. runDailyOptimization skipped autopilot_disabled (0 actions). checkBudgetWrite denied no_ceiling_configured. Rules present: scale_winner, cpa_over_target, frequency_bands, ctr_below_floor, kill_no_conversions. None fired.

proofs.expected: After simulate, this client has a letter pack (or named optimize columns) if the machine is supposed to ship one
proofs.observed: No public.letters_generated table (to_regclass null). letters_generated is a pipeline stage on the optimization pipeline, not a table. Before generate: dispute_letters=0, dispute_cases=0, dispute_items=0, diy_* custom_fields={}, no optimize columns on clients. Simulate writes clients/crs_results/tradelines/card/bank only. Compare client also 0 dispute_letters.

proofs.expected: Designed metro2 entry (from-crs → buildDiyPackage; tests also use deliverDiyPackageInRepo) builds a letter pack from this stored CRS
proofs.observed: Stored crs_results.result has top-level tradelines with bureau=EX|EQ|TU, no bureaus map, no sourceType, no creditFiles, no inquiries. violationsByBureauFromMergedCrs(stored) = {}. buildDiyPackage ok=true letterCount=0. persistDiyPackageFiles writes documents, not letters_generated, and does not mail. Persist skipped. PostGrid not called.

proofs.expected: Letter HTML exists (file, column, or rendered string) for this client
proofs.observed: generateLetter returns plain text, not HTML. renderLetterPdf makes PDF. No HTML column on dispute_letters (body_text). Designed pack emitted only 3 instruction .txt files (start-here, decision-tree, round-tracker). No letter PDF. No letter HTML. Sample text has no account names.

proofs.expected: Letters name Chase Sapphire Preferred / Amex Blue Business Cash / Capital One Spark / Toyota Motor Credit, right bureaus (EX/EQ/TU/EX), ids SIM-*-001, no lorem, no invented collections/chargeoffs/inquiries
proofs.observed: Designed pack names none of the four accounts and none of the ids. No EX/EQ/TU letter files. No lorem. No invented collections (pack had no dispute letters). Diagnostic wrap of the same seed into bureau envelopes also yielded 0 violations — clean revolving/installment with no Metro 2 codes, so the engine stayed silent rather than inventing derogatories.

proofs.observed: W-OPT wrote 0 rows. After in-process generate: dispute_letters=0, dispute_cases=0, documents letter-pack=0, diy custom_fields={}. One documents row now on this client is W-DESKS (kind=client_upload, original_filename=w-desks-ftc-audit.pdf), not W-OPT.
